I farm 0.85 hectares of maize here in Dodoma, where the rains can be unpredictable. Chemical fertilizer is too expensive and risky for me, especially since I never attended school, but I have livestock and will spread manure on this plot instead. I will plant seed I saved from last season because local maize handles dry spells better. My family will do the hoe work, though I may hire a few hands when the weeds are heavy.
